properties.OutageReportInfo: UPDATE- 9:58pm- Crews have found trees blown down on the line. They are in the process of removing the trees. Estimated time of restoration is 10:45pm. Power to customers in Rencontre East and Pool's Cove should now be restored.  Crews working to restore the power in the remaining communities.   Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro wish to advise customers of an unplanned power outage to the listed communities, currently under investigation, no current estimated time of restoration. Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro apologizes to its customers for any inconvenience this outage may cause.
